description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art young man with green hair in a half-up bun: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. The upper hair is tied in a small bun on top and the rest hangs loose. Paint only inside the white of the mask: the loose lower hair falling over the nape to the shoulders, and seen from the front the loose locks beside the face, drawn as a few layered, slightly wavy locks with darker lines between them, the ends tapered into points of different lengths, never one straight horizontal cut. The same bright grass green as the hair above, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. Do not change the bun, the hair on top, the bangs, the face, the long pointed ears, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
